data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'on' meaning 'against' and 'phrene' meaning 'heart'. The name Onfre signifies being free from the heart's afflictions or free from suffering. This name is often given to children born during times of struggle or to provide hope and strength. The name Onfre carries the meaning “Free from” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Onfre usually hope their child will grow to embody free from and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Onfre belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Free from.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Onfre total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
